privacy.main:
Privacy and content protection

How we protect and handle your content

Last updated: October 4, 2026

We process content only to provide the features you choose and necessary support. Different features may use processing on your device, on our servers or a combination of both. This page explains current data flows and your choices.

When you choose a feature that requires an online connection or cloud processing, relevant video, audio, images, text and necessary metadata may be uploaded or transmitted to our services and necessary service providers to complete that feature. The descriptions below explain the currently enabled data flows. New or changed upload processing will explain its purpose, transmitted content and storage arrangements before the feature is enabled, with authorization obtained when required.

Local videosFrame extraction, deduplication and exports take place in your browser by default. Original files remain on your device.
Online video linksThe server temporarily retrieves the video and returns it to your browser, where frames are extracted.
Highlights and accountsNecessary text or account information is sent to the server only when you choose to use online features.
Find the information you need
1. How each feature handles data2. Local tasks and browser data3. Information we may retain4. Online links and temporary files5. AI highlights and sensitive content6. Third-party services7. Your choices8. Contact and updates

1. How each feature handles data

FeatureProcessing locationWhat is sent
Import a local video and extract framesYour browserOriginal videos, frame images and exports remain on your device by default.
Screen recordingYour browserRecordings are created on your device and continue through local processing. Your browser asks for permission to record your screen.
Paste an online video linkTemporary server retrieval and browser processingThe link, permission confirmation and information needed for retrieval are sent to our server. Media is temporarily retrieved and returned to your browser. The normal process removes temporary files when the request ends.
Text recognitionYour browserFrame images are recognized in your browser. The browser may download recognition scripts and language models from public content delivery services.
Local transcriptionYour browserAudio is decoded and recognized on your device. Your browser may need to download transcription models.
Highlights and illustrated notesOur server and AI service providersThe transcript you submit, file name, output language and context needed for generation. The original video remains on your device.
Sign-in, plans and paymentsOur server and necessary service providersAccount details, email, plan, usage and order status. Full payment card details are handled by the payment provider. We do not store full card numbers.

2. Local tasks and browser data

To help you resume an interrupted task, your browser saves a draft of your most recent task on your device, including the original file, extracted frames, text and frame order. These drafts are stored only on your device. After refreshing the page, you can select “Continue previous task” to restore it. Saving another task replaces the previous draft. Your browser also stores small amounts of information locally, including sign-in state, output preferences and anonymous free usage allowances. You can clear this website’s data in your browser settings to delete drafts and these local records. You will need to sign in again afterward.

3. Information we may retain

To provide account, plan, payment, usage, abuse prevention and support services, we may retain your username, email, sign-in times, plan status, feature usage, order status, support requests and necessary diagnostic information. Payment and accounting records are retained as required by law or payment providers. Other service data is retained only for the time needed to provide features and resolve issues.

When you send a message through the contact form or email, we receive the name you provide (optional), reply email, subject and message to process and respond to your request and provide necessary support. The information is delivered to our support staff through email services. Please avoid submitting sensitive information unrelated to your request. You can request access to or deletion of relevant support records through the contact page.

4. Online links and temporary files

Online video platforms may require sign-in, restrict downloads or use DRM. Vid2PPT follows the source platform’s access and download rules. Only submit content you own or are authorized to process. When a link import succeeds, the server returns temporary media to your browser. Failed requests may retain limited technical logs to help identify the source, status and error. Your content is used only for the requested processing, excluding advertising training and content sales.

5. AI highlights and sensitive content

When you choose to generate highlights or illustrated notes, necessary text is sent to AI services. Only submit text needed for generation that you are authorized to process, and remove unrelated identity documents, bank cards, passwords, medical records, trade secrets and third-party private information you are not authorized to use. Frame extraction, text recognition and local transcription can be used independently.

6. Third-party services

We may use hosting, database, payment, AI, email, content delivery and logging services to provide website features. These providers receive only the information needed for the relevant feature and process data under their own privacy policies. The contact form uses Cloudflare Turnstile verification to reduce automated spam. Cloudflare processes necessary device, browser and network signals during verification. Third-party video links are also subject to the source platform’s own terms.

7. Your choices

  • Use only local file import and processing features.
  • Close the page and delete locally downloaded files at any time.
  • Clear browser storage, sign out or stop using an online feature.
  • Contact us to request access to, correction of or deletion of server-side account information, except accounting records that must be retained by law.

8. Contact and updates

If the product’s data flows change materially, we will update the date and explanation on this page. For privacy, account or data questions, contact info@vid2ppt.com.

terms-and-conditions.main:
Legal and service information

Terms of service

Last updated: October 4, 2026

Thank you for using Vid2PPT. These terms explain how we provide the service, how you may use it and the rules each party must follow. By using Vid2PPT, you acknowledge that you understand and agree to these terms.

Overview: Vid2PPT helps you organize courses, meetings, tutorials and presentation videos into key frames, PPTX, PDF, frame images, transcripts, highlights and illustrated notes. Automated results may include omissions or recognition errors. Review them before use or sharing.

Find the information you need
1. Services and data processing2. Lawful use and content rights3. Third-party platforms and copyright4. Accounts, redemption codes and security5. Outputs and manual review6. Free plans, paid plans and usage7. Payments, subscriptions and taxes8. Refunds, Lifetime and product lifecycle9. Service changes, suspension and termination10. Third-party services11. Disclaimer12. Limitation of liability13. Updates to these terms14. Contact us

1. Services and data processing

Vid2PPT currently provides local video import, screen recording, key-frame extraction, similar-frame deduplication, frame review and cropping, PPTX/PDF/frame image exports, OCR, transcription and optional highlights and illustrated notes. Supporting features such as image-to-PPTX conversion and PDF page cleanup are available as shown on the product pages.

  • Local files and screen recordingVideo reading, frame extraction, deduplication and basic exports take place in your browser. Original local videos for these operations are processed only on your device.
  • Local OCR and transcriptionText recognition and speech transcription run in your browser. The first use or a model update may require an internet connection to download scripts or model files. The local media being processed remains on your device.
  • Online video linksWhen you paste a supported public link, the server temporarily retrieves media it can process and returns it to your browser. Temporary files are removed after transfer. Whether a link can be processed depends on the source platform, content permissions and third-party service status.
  • AI highlights and illustrated notesWhen you use these online features, transcripts and text necessary for generation are sent to our server and relevant model services. The page explains sign-in or connection requirements before the feature is called.

Some features depend on your browser, device performance, video encoding, network connection, hosting, payment services, models or other third-party capabilities. Processing performance may differ across devices, sources and file formats.

2. Lawful use and content rights

You retain the rights you legally hold in content you upload, record, process or generate. You must confirm that you have lawful rights to use the relevant video, audio, images, course materials, meeting materials, web content or other materials, or have obtained the necessary authorization. Do not use Vid2PPT to process infringing, unlawful, malicious, fraudulent, harassing, hateful, pornographic, violent or restricted content, or content that violates another person’s privacy.

To complete the features you choose, you authorize Vid2PPT and the service providers necessary for those features to transmit, temporarily store, process and generate related outputs within the necessary scope and duration, including video, audio, images, text and metadata required for the feature. This authorization does not transfer ownership of your content or permit its sale or use for unrelated purposes. Upload, storage and cleanup arrangements for current and future cloud features are governed by feature descriptions and the privacy policy. Additional authorization will be obtained separately when required.

3. Third-party platforms and copyright

If you process content from YouTube, Bilibili, online course platforms, meeting platforms or other third-party sources, you must comply with the relevant platform’s terms, copyright rules and local laws. Vid2PPT requires users to respect paywalls, digital rights management, access controls, download restrictions and other copyright protection measures. Bypassing these measures is outside the scope authorized by this service.

4. Accounts, redemption codes and security

If you use account, redemption code or subscription features, keep your sign-in methods and payment information secure and take responsibility for activity under your account. If you use this product on behalf of a company, school, team or other organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these terms on its behalf.

5. Outputs and manual review

Automated outputs such as frame extraction, deduplication, OCR, transcription, highlights and illustrated notes may contain omissions, duplicates, recognition errors or inaccuracies. We continue to improve results, but cannot guarantee that outputs are complete, accurate or suitable for any particular purpose. Review them manually before submission, publication, citation, study, commercial use or external sharing.

6. Free plans, paid plans and usage

Limits for video duration, conversion count, OCR pages, transcription minutes, highlights and illustrated notes, batch processing and online links are set out in the relevant plan descriptions. We may adjust free allowances, plan features and prices based on product costs, third-party service changes, abuse prevention or operational needs. For the current service period already purchased, we will make reasonable efforts to keep core benefits stable, except where affected by legal requirements, platform policies, objective circumstances that could not be foreseen, avoided or overcome, or service security.

7. Payments, subscriptions and taxes

Paid services may be processed by third-party payment providers. Prices, taxes, currency, renewal intervals and payment conditions shown at checkout govern the purchase. Subscription plans may renew periodically unless you cancel before the next billing period. Before paying, check the plan, purchase email, currency, taxes and invoice information.

8. Refunds, Lifetime and product lifecycle

Refunds are governed by the refund policy. “Permanent,” “Lifetime” and similar descriptions mean access to the benefits described on the relevant plan page while the Vid2PPT website and related services continue to operate. The benefit period is limited to the actual operating period of the website and related services. Permanent service availability and service for the purchaser’s natural lifetime are not promised.

If the product closes due to circumstances beyond our control, unsustainable operating costs, changes to third-party services, changes in laws or policies, team operating changes or other reasonable causes, we will make reasonable efforts to provide advance notice. We may offer migration advice, export instructions, alternative tool recommendations or advisory documents as a goodwill arrangement. These arrangements are limited to the stated documents or advice. Cash refunds, equivalent compensation and continued service are not promised.

9. Service changes, suspension and termination

We may continue to improve, replace, limit, suspend or discontinue some features. We may suspend or terminate services due to service security issues, abuse, legal requirements, third-party service outages, unsustainable operating costs, product closure or other reasonable circumstances. We will try to minimize the impact on normal users where reasonably practicable.

10. Third-party services

This product may link to or integrate third-party services, including hosting, payments, AI models, browser capabilities, open-source components, analytics or email services. Their availability, prices, policies and outputs are determined by their providers and are not entirely within our control. Their terms and privacy policies may also apply when you use them.

11. Disclaimer

To the extent permitted by law, Vid2PPT is provided “as is” and “as available.” We maintain the service carefully, but do not guarantee continuous availability, freedom from errors or vulnerabilities, compatibility with every browser and video format, or complete accuracy of automated outputs.

12. Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, we exclude liability for indirect, incidental, special, punitive or consequential losses, including lost profits, data loss, business interruption, loss of goodwill, third-party claims or losses arising from your use of outputs. Where applicable law requires liability to be retained, our liability is limited to the minimum extent permitted by law.

13. Updates to these terms

We may update these terms as the product, payment channels, third-party services or legal requirements change. Updated terms will be published on this page, with the update date shown at the top. Continuing to use Vid2PPT after an update means you accept the updated terms.

14. Contact us

For questions about terms, payments, privacy, copyright or product use, contact info@vid2ppt.com. We will make reasonable efforts to review and respond to your request.

refund.main:
Billing and after-sales support

Refund policy

Last updated: August 10, 2026

This policy explains refunds and after-sales support for Vid2PPT paid plans, subscriptions, temporary access and Lifetime benefits. We encourage you to try the product thoroughly before purchasing, understand the differences between plans and follow a clear support process if you encounter a problem.

Core rule: Vid2PPT is an immediately delivered digital service. Unless required by applicable law, expressly stated at checkout or agreed by us in writing, digital services that have been activated, delivered, consumed or used to download exported results are generally non-refundable.

Contact billing supportHow to cancel renewalPaid but access is not active
Find the information you need
1. Try before purchasing2. Refund limits for digital services3. Circumstances generally not eligible for refunds4. Handling service problems5. Subscription cancellation6. Special conditions for Lifetime7. Temporary plans and one-time digital products8. Duplicate payments and billing errors9. How to request a refund10. Policy updates

1. Try before purchasing

We offer a Free plan or free trial features so you can test your real materials before purchasing, including your device, browser, video format, file size, frame extraction and deduplication, and outputs such as PPTX, PDF, frame images, transcripts, highlights and illustrated notes. Because core processing depends on browser capabilities and local device performance, we recommend completing a test close to your actual use case before purchasing.

2. Refund limits for digital services

Once paid features are activated, users can immediately use digital benefits such as video conversions, OCR pages, transcription allowances, highlights and illustrated notes, batch processing and exports. Digital results cannot be returned like physical goods once generated or downloaded. Purchases are therefore generally non-refundable, except where required by law or in special circumstances we confirm.

3. Circumstances generally not eligible for refunds

  • Changing your mind after purchase, no longer needing the service, choosing the wrong plan or forgetting to cancel a subscription in time.
  • Not reading plan limits, feature descriptions, browser requirements, the terms of service or this refund policy.
  • An experience that differs from expectations due to your device, browser, memory, network, video encoding, damaged files, extensions or system permissions.
  • Using paid allowances, generating highlights or illustrated notes, exporting PPTX/PDF, downloading frame images, processing files in batches or otherwise consuming the service.
  • Links that cannot be processed due to the online video source, copyright restrictions, platform restrictions, regional restrictions or third-party service changes.
  • Violating the terms of service, processing content you have no right to use, abusing the service or trying to bypass product limits.

4. Handling service problems

If you believe a paid Vid2PPT feature has a serious technical problem, contact our support email within 7 days of purchase. Include the order number, purchase email, plan name, browser version, device information, video format, error screenshots and steps to reproduce the issue. We will make reasonable efforts to investigate and may, depending on the circumstances, offer usage guidance, compensatory allowances, an extension of the service period, an alternative approach or another reasonable resolution. These arrangements are limited to the specified resolution. Cash refunds remain subject to this policy and any specific written agreement.

5. Subscription cancellation

If you purchased a subscription, cancel renewal before your next billing date using the subscription management link in your payment confirmation or billing email. If the email has no management link or you cannot complete cancellation, contact billing support and provide your order number and purchase email so we can help you verify the cancellation process.

Cancellation generally stops future billing only. The current paid period continues until its expiry date, and its payment is generally retained.

6. Special conditions for Lifetime

“Permanent,” “Lifetime” and similar descriptions mean that the purchaser can use the relevant benefits described on the plan page at purchase while the Vid2PPT website, product and related services continue to operate. The benefit period is limited to the actual operating period of the website and related services. Permanent service availability and service for the purchaser’s natural lifetime are not promised.

If Vid2PPT stops operating, cannot continue providing the service for an extended period or closes the relevant website due to circumstances beyond our control, unsustainable operating costs, third-party platform or service interruptions, changes in laws or policies, payment channel restrictions, team operating changes, changes in product direction or other reasonable causes, Lifetime benefits will continue until the website or corresponding service stops operating. We will make reasonable efforts to notify users in advance and may offer export instructions, migration advice, alternative tool recommendations, user guides or advisory documents as a goodwill arrangement. These arrangements are limited to the specified documents or advice. Cash refunds, equivalent compensation, continued operation and additional service obligations are not promised.

7. Temporary plans and one-time digital products

Temporary plans, one-time passes, pay-per-use purchases, export packages and other one-time digital products are generally activated immediately after purchase and can be consumed. They are non-refundable unless required by applicable law or expressly stated by us.

8. Duplicate payments and billing errors

If you believe there has been a duplicate charge, an incorrect amount, payment without access activation, an incorrect subscription status or another billing problem, contact us promptly. We will work with the payment provider to investigate. If a payment or system error is confirmed, we will make reasonable efforts to help correct it.

9. How to request a refund

Contact billing support: Email info@vid2ppt.com with your order number, purchase email, purchase date, plan name, description of the problem and screenshots. Complete information helps us assess and handle the request promptly.

10. Policy updates

We may update this refund policy based on the product, payment channels, legal requirements or operational circumstances. Updated policies will be published on this page, with the update date shown at the top. The page descriptions and checkout terms that applied at purchase may also be relevant to the assessment.
